skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of financial systems and financial analysts in businesses.
Apply and analyze financial situations based on company financial reports.
Understand and calculate various types of interest rates, cash flows, and analyze household and business financial decisions.
Analyze and evaluate investment projects, understand market valuation principles, and asset pricing.
Apply financial theories to real-world financial analysis situations and use analytical tools to make financial decisions.
Work independently and in groups, organize discussions to solve class problems.
Have the ability to self-study, research, and organize group situations to achieve learning objectives.
Have a sense of discipline, cooperation, and responsibility in group activities.
